queries.title: Searches
queries.description: City or hotel searches as you would type them into Google, for example "hotels in Paris". Each row carries resolvedPlace, the place Google read the search as. A search Google does not recognise is skipped and not charged.

hotelUrls.title: Hotel URLs (coming soon)
hotelUrls.description: Coming soon: named-hotel tracking. Leave this empty for now. A run with hotel links stops at once and costs nothing; use Searches instead, for example "hotels in Paris".

checkInFrom.title: First check-in date
checkInFrom.description: First check-in date of the price calendar (YYYY-MM-DD), for example 2026-11-12. Defaults to tomorrow. Past dates are rejected before the run starts, so they never cost anything. For scheduled runs use First check-in, days ahead instead, so the date moves forward with every run.

checkInTo.title: Last check-in date
checkInTo.description: Last check-in date of the calendar. One search runs per check-in date in the range. Defaults to the first check-in date.

checkInFromDaysAhead.title: First check-in, days ahead
checkInFromDaysAhead.description: First check-in date as days after the run date: 0 is today, 7 is a week ahead. Use it instead of First check-in date for scheduled runs, so they never ask for a past date. Read an example.

checkInToDaysAhead.title: Last check-in, days ahead
checkInToDaysAhead.description: Last check-in date as days after the run date, for example 30. Defaults to the first check-in date. Read an example.

nights.title: Nights
nights.description: Stay length applied to every check-in date and echoed on every row, as Google reported it.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Adults per room. Prices change with occupancy.

children.title: Children
children.description: Number of children. Ages default to 8 unless set below.

childrenAges.title: Children's ages
childrenAges.description: Optional ages (0 to 17), one per child.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, INR or IDR.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country of the searcher. It pins the proxy country, because Google's prices follow the requester's country.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional: hotelClass (array of 2 to 5), amenities (for example ["freeWifi", "pool"]), minRating (for example 4.0), priceMin and priceMax (per night, in your currency).

includeOffers.title: Include per-site offers
includeOffers.description: Adds one row per booking site (Booking.com, Expedia, the hotel's own site and others) for each hotel and date. Each offer is a separate paid event. Read an example.

includeUnavailable.title: Include hotels without a price
includeUnavailable.description: Also return hotels Google lists without a price on that date (sold out or not bookable), with pricePerNight null and available false. These rows are not charged. Off by default.

maxHotelsPerQuery.title: Max hotels per search and date
maxHotelsPerQuery.description: Hard cost cap per search and check-in date.

canary.title: Drift canary (advanced)
canary.description: For scheduled monitoring runs. Example: {"baselineStore": "canary-baseline", "thresholdPoints": 5}. The first run saves the null rate of key fields (and the mix of a status field) to that named key-value store; later runs compare and fail with an alert if any value moves by more than thresholdPoints percentage points. Leave empty for normal runs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy pinned to the country above is recommended.
